selection_policy.description: Legacy regression includes every retained exposed set. Development selects min/median/max n+m per family, name tie break, among n+m<=20000; 4096 MiB and 900s process limits. No outcomes used. Size groups: <=1000 small, <=10000 medium, otherwise large.

holdout_policy: September 16: old reservations remain exposed regression data. Reserve LP_ship04s, SDP_copo14 and mixed SDP_filter48_socp before solver execution. Also reserve SOCP_strictmin_2D_43_dual from the geometric ARAP family, without any solve; enforce a 180s cap for this large case. Do not use reservations for development or remove failures after acceptance.
